children.note: Managed REST API endpoints with serverless auto-scaling, supporting >25K QPS with <50ms latency overhead; routes requests to UC-registered models with automatic monitoring.
SQL function for large-scale batch scoring of custom & foundation models; integrates with Lakeflow jobs for scheduled batch pipelines; supports streaming table updates.
Distributed scoring using custom Python/MLflow models registered in UC; scales across Spark cluster resources; alternative to ai_query for complex transformations.
Pre-packages model artifacts & dependencies during MLflow registration (requires Env 3+, MLflow 3.12+); skips container build; max 200 GB model size; supports CPU & GPU.
Dedicated inference capacity for foundation models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen); 1-3 month reservations; model-unit-based sizing; supports fine-tuned variants.

NVIDIA Triton-backed throughput optimization via dynamic request batching on GPU endpoints; requires batch-friendly models and explicit enablement; improves throughput at trade-off of per-request latency.
Automatic feature lookup from online store during inference; pre-defined FeatureSpec endpoints for sub-ms latency; integrates model serving with Lakebase online feature store.
Route traffic between multiple models on one endpoint (e.g., 90% Champion / 10% Challenger); configurable splits enable online evaluation and gradual rollouts without endpoint restart.
Immutable version history with automatic signatures; each version captures metadata, parameters, metrics, artifacts, source run; enables rollback and audit trails.
Mutable pointers (Champion, Staging, Prod aliases) to model versions; decouples promotion logic from inference code; enables A/B testing without code changes.
Three-level namespace (catalog.schema.model); fine-grained permissions (CREATE, EXECUTE, APPLY TAG); audit logging; cross-workspace discovery and access control.
Auto-capture of upstream UC datasets via mlflow.log_input(); visible in model-version pages; enables compliance traceability and data-to-model dependency tracking.
Interactive graph in Catalog Explorer showing data → features → training run → model version → serving; column-level lineage supported; tracks feature-engineering dependencies.
Custom tags and governed tags on models/versions; governance tags support approval workflows; enables classification, compliance labeling, and discovery.
Models accessible across workspaces via same UC metastore; catalog-binding configuration controls workspace visibility; enables shared MLOps practices across teams.
New model versions auto-trigger deployment jobs; reviewers approve via governed tags; integrates MLflow 3 with Lakeflow Jobs for gated production promotion.
